[ASSISTANT_SAID] Navigation Shortcuts: Win + D, Win + E, Win + L, Win + M, Win + R, Win + Tab, Win + Up arrow, Win + Down arrow, Win + Left/Right arrow.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Brightness and Volume Shortcuts: Fn + F2, Fn + F3, Fn + F5, Fn + F6, Fn + F7.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other Shortcuts: Fn + F1, Fn + F12, Fn + F11, Fn + Spacebar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Function Keys: F1-F12 have various functions depending on the program used.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips provided for finding the Fn key and adjusting keyboard settings.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided methods to customize the Fn key behavior:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Method 1: Using the BIOS Settings with steps to access and change the Fn key behavior.
